generator: generate_weapons.py (pure CPU, Pillow/NumPy, no external art)

safe_view.notes: Body frames keep the central aiming rectangle empty; muzzle/pipe tips may enter y>=190 only inside x 250..440. Forearms are deliberately cropped by the bottom edge, never by the sides.

frame_conventions.native_frame: Use each 640x400 RGBA frame as a full-screen bottom-layer sprite at (0,0).
frame_conventions.anchor: Frames are pre-anchored to the 640x400 viewport; no per-frame origin shifts needed.
frame_conventions.flash: Overlay flash PNGs at (0,0) on the same viewport; they are already aligned to the matching body frame.
frame_conventions.timings: duration_ms is the dwell time for that single image; raise order is raise_low -> raise_mid -> idle.
frame_conventions.warning: Mapping labels below are descriptive only. No engine API, ZScript function or runtime test is claimed.
